description: Unity UI Toolkit support boundary. Ordered; first match wins. Rules classify pointer families for the shapes the dispatcher admits (boolean form controls, select/toggle-item item groups, click-opened non-blocking anchored surfaces); whether a component is admitted at all is the dispatcher's decision, recorded per component in the capability inventory. `lowered` names what the emitter or shared C# runtime performs today; `pending` names the parity phase that will lower the family; `refused` states why UI Toolkit cannot realise the family idiomatically. Catch-all rules exist so that unknown prop families are never silently supported: an allowlisted component that reaches one fails generation until the family is adjudicated here.

phases.P2: Generic anatomy walker: ir.dom/ir.parts lower to a VisualElement tree; runtime bases become behavior mixins.
phases.P3: Styling projection: generated USS from token facts, variants, states and box-model geometry; hand-authored palette removed.
phases.P4: Interaction families: static pressables, blocking and hover surfaces, composite and non-boolean form controls, componentRef composition, messages, motion, typed C# declarations.
phases.P5: Corpus and admission: allowlist reaches the SwiftUI set; CI compile lane and committed-byte drift diff.

rules.reason: Authoring and validator metadata consumed by the contract validator; no target lowers it into runtime source.

rules.via: C# partial class name and the root USS class added in the generated constructor.

rules.reason: Documentation and classification metadata consumed by docs and audits; no target emits it into component source.
Agent-authoring metadata consumed by the a2ui runtime deriver, outside every emitter.
UI Toolkit panels are retained-mode and are never server-rendered or hydrated.
Icon flipping and row reversal are expressible as generated USS (flex-direction, scale) once styling projection exists; nothing honours rtl today.
The box-model geometry profile projects into generated USS slot defaults.

The generic anatomy walker lowers dom, parts and details into a VisualElement tree. Today the shared runtime bases hand-build their trees and honour only the part names that formControl, interaction and surface facts reference.
Slot anchors belong to the anatomy walker; Popover routing Add(child) into Content and item Add(child) are hand-written exceptions, not slot lowering.

rules.via: [UxmlAttribute] value property (Checked, Open, Value/Values) on the generated control; SetValueWithoutNotify / SetValuesWithoutNotify for silent updates.
Imperative initial assignment: a value assigned before panel attachment is the uncontrolled initial state; no separate default property is emitted.
RegisterValueChangedCallback for boolean channels and the ValueChanged C# event for selection channels; Controlled + ValueRequested realise the owner-controlled half of the trio.

rules.reason: HTML form submission fields (name, value) have no UI Toolkit counterpart: there is no form element to serialise into.

rules.via: [UxmlAttribute] Disabled mapped to SetEnabled on the control root; disabled activation leaves state unchanged.

[UxmlAttribute] Collapsible, Loop, UnmountInactive, Orientation, ActivationMode and SelectionType on ItemGroup, emitted only when the contract declares the prop, initialised from the declared default.

rules.reason: Appearance is exposed as an ItemGroup string property and class but no generated USS realises the declared appearance values.

rules.via: [UxmlAttribute] CloseOnEscape / CloseOnOutsideClick / CloseOnBlur on AnchoredSurface, initialised from the declared defaults; only triggers the surface declares are enabled.
[UxmlAttribute] Placement on AnchoredSurface; floating content flips and shifts at panel edges.

rules.reason: Only the default (md) geometry is lowered from typed token facts; other sizes arrive with USS projection.
DOM id generation exists to wire ARIA relationships; UI Toolkit has no id-referenced accessibility relationships.
DOM attribute passthrough; UI Toolkit controls expose typed properties, not arbitrary host attributes.
Prop families not yet adjudicated for UI Toolkit. An allowlisted component may not rely on this rule: add a family rule above.

rules.via: Each channel's value/default/change trio maps to the C# value property, pre-attachment assignment and change callback or event; Controlled + ValueRequested carry owner-controlled state.

rules.reason: Named types lower to C# string/bool today; enums, unions and records need typed C# declarations.
Variant axes project into generated USS modifier classes; no variant styling is generated today.
is-checked / is-selected classes are hand-written in the runtime bases; generic state dimensions and their styling arrive with USS projection.
USS has no @keyframes; it supports property transitions only. Keyframe animation would need a scheduler-driven C# runtime, which is not an idiomatic lowering of a stylesheet fact.
USS transitions, loops and reduced-motion gating are not generated yet.

rules.via: Channel change events surface as RegisterValueChangedCallback (boolean) and the ValueChanged C# event (selection); C# signatures use arrays for both selection modes.

rules.reason: Transitions are implemented by hand in ItemGroup and AnchoredSurface; there is no generic state-machine lowering.
No HTML form participation, constraint validation or field association exists in UI Toolkit.

rules.via: The dispatcher selects the BooleanControl base for boolean value models.
Configure(part, prefix) names the trigger element; the channel selects the generated C# value property and constants.
BooleanControl commits on trigger activation, which is the change moment of a boolean control; there is no intermediate input phase to defer.

rules.reason: Non-boolean value models and commit policies need their own runtime base and an explicit decision here.
Composite controls (Select, RadioGroup, …) need a composite runtime base; the dispatcher rejects them today.

rules.via: The dispatcher selects ItemGroup for select / toggle-item and AnchoredSurface for toggle; Configure(operation, …) carries the operation into the runtime.
Configure(operation, triggerPart, contentPart, prefix) names the trigger and content elements; the channel selects the generated value property and constants.
The named prop is emitted as [UxmlAttribute] Disabled and gates activation through SetEnabled.
ItemGroup hides inactive content and detaches it when UnmountInactive is set; AnchoredSurface removes floating content on close.

rules.reason: Other operations (open, close, …), multi-trigger interactions and remaining interaction facts have no runtime base and need an explicit decision here.

rules.via: ItemGroup Orientation and Loop defaults when the contract declares no orientation/loop prop.
ItemGroup implements roving and manual arrow navigation with Home/End; auto and none defer to native UI Toolkit focus on the trigger button.
ItemGroup moves initial focus to the trigger or tab element the contract names.

rules.reason: Prose description of the focus strategy; documentation only.
Focus trapping, restoration and other focus facts are not lowered and need an explicit decision here.

rules.via: Enabled portals reparent floating content to the panel root and re-attach the stylesheet (AnchoredSurface); disabled portals keep content in the document tree.
AnchoredSurface CloseOnEscape / CloseOnOutsideClick / CloseOnBlur over the anchor/content union.
The named prop is emitted as the matching [UxmlAttribute] CloseOn* flag.
An empty trigger list declares no dismissal; the runtime bases register none.

rules.reason: pointer-leave, close-button and other dismissal triggers need the blocking and hover surface bases and an explicit decision here.

rules.via: The dispatcher selects AnchoredSurface for non-blocking surfaces.
The trigger Button's clicked event toggles the surface.
Configure(anchorPart, contentPart, prefix) names the trigger and floating content; interactive content receives focus and scrolls.

rules.reason: aria-controls / aria-expanded relations have no assistive-technology consumer in UI Toolkit.

rules.via: AnchoredSurface anchors to the trigger, reads the Placement property and flip-shifts at panel edges; persistent surfaces keep their content object while closed.

rules.reason: Blocking modality, hover/focus open triggers and remaining surface facts need the blocking and hover surface bases and an explicit decision here.
Id-referenced ARIA relationships; UI Toolkit exposes no assistive-technology tree that could consume them.

rules.via: ItemGroup arrow / Home / End navigation and native Button submit activation (Space / Enter) through NavigationSubmitEvent.

rules.reason: Roles, labels and ARIA attributes have no runtime consumer: UI Toolkit exposes no assistive-technology tree on desktop, and Unity's mobile AccessibilityHierarchy is not populated by UI Toolkit. Revisit when that integration exists.
The component message catalog is not lowered for Unity; generated controls carry no localisable text.
Truncation policy needs USS text-overflow projection and a measuring runtime.
Sequence and paged-set position policies need their own runtime base.

rules.via: Typed px fallback facts assign TrackWidth, TrackHeight and ThumbSize in the generated constructor.

rules.reason: Token bindings project into generated USS variables; today only the default-size geometry fallbacks are read.
Style declarations project into generated USS; the shipped stylesheet is hand-authored.
